Organisations and executives learn about their reputational exposure too late and cannot tell a real signal from noise or a coordinated campaign.

Collect adverse-media signals, score them for strength, noise, narrative coherence and likelihood of manipulation, and alert when an early-warning signal rises. Defensive only.

It draws on these skills: [Narrative and reputation analysis](@/skills/narrative-analysis.md), [Source reliability](@/skills/source-reliability.md), [Continuous monitoring](@/skills/change-monitoring.md), [OSINT investigation](@/skills/osint-investigation.md) and [Decision support](@/skills/decision-support.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [Broadway](@/glossary/broadway.md), [Ollama](@/glossary/ollama.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md) and [Phoenix](@/glossary/phoenix.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md), [CSS](@/glossary/css.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md) and [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md).

9 public repositories show its skills (9 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
